title: Elysia rate limit and product cache
context: Elysia plugins. The rate limit allows 100 requests per IP per minute. There is no proxy in front of the service; the client IP comes from server.requestIP(request). Product prices change every hour.
code: const hits = new Map<string, { count: number; reset: number }>();
export const rateLimit = new Elysia({ name: "rate-limit" })
export const products = new Elysia({ name: "products" })

expected.why: trusts the client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header, so a client can change it on every request to bypass the limit
>= blocks the 100th request; the limit allows 100 per window, so the check must be > LIMIT
Retry-After is in seconds, but this sends milliseconds
cache entries never expire, so hourly price changes are never seen (and the map grows without bound)
